title: SeedEvidence
description: Template seed schema establishing the AEP evidence JSON Schema baseline. Demonstrates the pinned-draft, $id, title, type, required, properties, and additionalProperties:false convention for all AEP evidence schemas. Milestone 4 evidence schemas (checkpoint-evidence, replay-evidence, artifact-attestation) mirror this structure.

seed_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence record

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the record was created
